g.text: A card unlocks the first time you play as them
His workshop at Amarna was dug up in 1912,
and the famous bust of Nefertiti was found there.
Where to see it: the Neues Museum, Berlin.
Our face is invented, drawn in raised
relief, which was his own medium.
11 of 24 works unlocked. Visit a scene to unlock its work.
A nobleman hunts birds from a papyrus boat while a
cat leaps at the birds. We drew our own marsh in this
style; the cat is ours too.
Where to see the real fragments:
Redrawn from the style, not copied
from a photograph. See the credits.
